definitions.explanation: The outer covering of the human body. More technical/medical than {肌|はだ}.

examples.japanese: {皮膚|ひふ}が{乾燥|かんそう}している。
{紫外線|しがいせん}は{皮膚|ひふ}に{悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Ultraviolet rays have a bad effect on the skin.

notes:
USAGE: Medical/scientific term for skin. More formal than {肌|はだ}.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{皮膚科|ひふか} (dermatology)
・{皮膚|ひふ}{炎|えん} (dermatitis)
・{皮膚|ひふ}{病|びょう} (skin disease)
・{皮膚|ひふ}{癌|がん} (skin cancer)

CONTRAST:
・{肌|はだ} - skin (everyday, often about texture/beauty)
・{皮|かわ} - skin/hide (of animals, or as outer layer)
